response.sql: WITH s AS (SELECT c.state_county_province AS st, COUNT(a.account_id) AS cnt FROM Customers c LEFT JOIN Accounts a ON a.customer_id = c.customer_id GROUP BY c.state_county_province), sh AS (SELECT st, cnt, cnt * 1.0 / (SELECT SUM(cnt) FROM s) AS share FROM s), av AS (SELECT AVG(share) AS avg_share FROM sh) SELECT SUM(sh.cnt) AS combined_account_base, AVG(sh.share) AS average_share, AVG(sh.share - av.avg_share) AS avg_excess_over_average_share FROM sh, av WHERE sh.share > av.avg_share
